[Víctor García Carrasco]{.hero-name}

[Simulation, predictive modelling and optimisation for energy and water systems]{.hero-role}

I'm a physicist with a PhD from the Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC), where I teach simulation and combinatorial optimisation. For years I've built models to understand complex systems and make better decisions, from the spread of an epidemic to the Iberian electricity mix and water management in Catalonia. Now I want to bring that toolkit to applied problems in industry.

[Lecturer at UPC · Open to industry roles in energy, data science and R&D · Barcelona area]{.status}

## What I do

::: {.skills}
::: {}
<i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i>

#### Simulation

Discrete-event, system dynamics, agent-based models and digital twins.
:::

::: {}
<i class="bi bi-graph-up"></i>

#### Predictive modelling

Time series, regression and autoregressive models, machine learning and deep learning.
:::

::: {}
<i class="bi bi-signpost-split"></i>

#### Optimisation

Combinatorial and multi-objective optimisation. Metaheuristics (genetic algorithms, particle swarm), exact methods and Bayesian search.
:::

::: {}
<i class="bi bi-lightning-charge"></i>

#### Energy & water

Iberian electricity mix, wholesale prices, storage and the water–energy nexus.
:::

::: {}
<i class="bi bi-code-slash"></i>

#### Scientific software

Fast, production-ready Python: vectorisation, Numba, memoisation and parallel processing. LLM-assisted development of web front ends.
:::

::: {}
<i class="bi bi-bar-chart-line"></i>

#### Quantitative finance

Portfolio management, asset allocation and quantitative analysis.
:::
:::
